perspective:
Jose’s available information includes:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn and down than usual during shifts, especially since she is normally vibrant.
- He approached her and asked if she was okay. She said it was “nothing really, just some personal stuff” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen or be there if she wanted to talk. Patricia said she appreciated it and that it meant a lot.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He mentioned he had been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them. Patricia said that could be helpful because she had been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips with her whenever she felt up to it. She thanked him and said she would take him up on it soon.
- He later worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he told Patricia he wanted to help, not pry. She reassured him she didn’t see it as prying and was grateful.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. Patricia said she appreciated that and was glad she had someone to turn to.
- Since then, he has continued checking in with her. She said she was doing fine and planning a quiet weekend. He reminded her he was available if she needed anything.
- He continues to offer support at work, like helping out or grabbing coffee. Patricia said she was busy but handling things, thanked him, and said it was great to have his support.
- His overall impression is that Patricia is dealing with some personal and financial stress, prefers to handle things privately, but appreciates his friendly support.
